chat.fiatlux.war_in_heaven: There was war in heaven (Rev 12:7): %s rebel angels gather in %s near %s %s %s. Michael and his angels muster against them. Defeat the rebels, or speak Cast Out.
choir.fiatlux.angels.office: Third sphere: messengers, ministering spirits sent forth to minister.
choir.fiatlux.archangels.office: Third sphere: captains of the Host; the voice of the archangel and the trump of God.
choir.fiatlux.cherubim.office: First sphere: the living creatures who guard the way of the tree of life and bear the throne.
choir.fiatlux.dominions.office: Second sphere: they govern the offices of the lower choirs; their sceptre strengthens those beneath them.
choir.fiatlux.powers.office: Second sphere: the warrior choir that holds the fallen in chains.
choir.fiatlux.principalities.office: Third sphere: princes set over peoples and nations; they guard the mortals in their keeping.
choir.fiatlux.seraphim.office: First sphere: the burning ones who cry Holy, Holy, Holy before the throne.
choir.fiatlux.thrones.office: First sphere: the wheels within wheels, full of eyes, on which the glory moves.
choir.fiatlux.virtues.office: Second sphere: spirits through whom signs and miracles are done; they heal and lift afflictions.
command.fiatlux.host.header: The celestial hierarchy - nine choirs in three spheres:
command.fiatlux.life: Life is breathed upon that world.
command.fiatlux.life.fail: That world cannot receive life (unknown, uninhabitable, or already alive).
command.fiatlux.mode.set: This world is now in %s mode.
command.fiatlux.pilgrim.on: %s now walks as a mortal pilgrim.
command.fiatlux.planet.full: The cosmos holds as many worlds as this server allows (maxPlanets).
command.fiatlux.undo: Your last act is being undone.
fiatlux.configuration.bigBangGalaxies: Galaxies Born of the Big Bang
fiatlux.configuration.title: Fiat Lux Configuration
item.fiatlux.divine_scepter.verse: "And God said, Let there be light" - Genesis 1:3
item.fiatlux.flaming_sword_of_cherubim.v: "...a flaming sword which turned every way" - Genesis 3:24
item.fiatlux.fruit_of_knowledge: Fruit of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil
item.fiatlux.fruit_of_life: Fruit of the Tree of Life
message.fiatlux.cain.warning: Sin lies at Cain's door. Sneak and use Cain to bless him before it masters him - or let it be.
message.fiatlux.eden.ate_knowledge: Your eyes are opened. You know good, and you know evil.
message.fiatlux.eden.ate_life: Life flows through you, as from a river that never runs dry.
message.fiatlux.eden.planted: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed. (Genesis 2:8)
message.fiatlux.eden.serpent_driven_off: The serpent slips away into the grass. The tempter will return.
message.fiatlux.exhausted: Your Divine Essence must be renewed.
message.fiatlux.faith.answered: You have answered the prayers of %s. Their faith is renewed.
message.fiatlux.faith.schism: %s of %s has turned away from you and founded the %s, worshipping %s.
message.fiatlux.fell_into_abyss: You fall through %s, the bottomless pit, into the Underworld. (Revelation 9:1-2)
message.fiatlux.flood.already: %s is already in the days of the ark on %s.
message.fiatlux.flood.begun: %s has found grace in your eyes, and goes to build the ark on %s.
message.fiatlux.flood.covenant: "I will not again smite any more every thing living, as I have done" (Genesis 8:21). The bow is in the cloud: there is no second Flood.
message.fiatlux.flood.grieved: The earth is filled with violence. Say "Make thee an ark" on this world to set its most righteous man building, or let the age run on.
message.fiatlux.flood.no_ground: There is no ground here level enough for an ark three hundred cubits long.
message.fiatlux.flood.none_righteous: There is no one here to build an ark. Go to a world where mortals live.
message.fiatlux.formed_from_dust: "And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul." (Genesis 2:7)
message.fiatlux.heaven_closed: The gates of Heaven are closed to pilgrims in this world.
message.fiatlux.left_world: You rise out of the skies of %s into the Expanse.
message.fiatlux.mortal.greets: %1$s, a %3$s of the %2$s age on %4$s, greets you.
message.fiatlux.mortal.praying: %1$s, a %3$s of the %2$s age on %4$s, is kneeling in prayer.
message.fiatlux.nephilim.none: There is no town here for the Watchers to come down upon.
message.fiatlux.no_lifeless_world: There is no habitable world still waiting for life.
message.fiatlux.no_universe: The void is without form: speak the Cosmic Spark first.
message.fiatlux.no_worlds: No world has yet been formed. Speak Planetary Genesis.
message.fiatlux.pilgrim: You walk as a mortal pilgrim; divine power is not yours to wield.
message.fiatlux.planet_formed: %s is formed: a %s world, set in its orbit.
message.fiatlux.rift.opened: A rift tears open in the earth: %s come up out of the pit, seeking those of weak faith.
message.fiatlux.soul.arrives_heaven: The soul of %s of %s is taken up into Heaven.
message.fiatlux.soul.arrives_underworld: The soul of %s of %s falls into the Underworld.
message.fiatlux.soul.redeemed: You redeem the soul of %s: it rises into Heaven.
message.fiatlux.void_expanse: The Cosmic Expanse: fly to a world to descend upon it; return through Heaven's Gate behind you.
message.fiatlux.void_formless: The earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. (Genesis 1:2) - Speak Let There Be Light, or the Cosmic Spark.
message.fiatlux.watch.sent: Guardian angels go down to the %s living worlds: %s towns are kept now, and the rest will be as soon as anyone is near them.
message.fiatlux.world_unformed: That world is without form, and void.
power.fiatlux.ascend.desc: Ascend to Heaven, or descend again to the earth. (Gen 28:12)
power.fiatlux.bless.desc: "The LORD bless thee, and keep thee." Blesses the creature you behold, or yourself. (Num 6:24)
power.fiatlux.bottomless_pit.desc: Revelation 9:1-2. In the Void, collapses the place you gaze into a black hole: its pull draws in all that strays near, and its horizon opens on the Underworld.
power.fiatlux.bottomless_pit.only_void: The bottomless pit can be opened only in the Void, after the Big Bang.
power.fiatlux.breath_of_life.desc: "...breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul." (Gen 2:7)
power.fiatlux.cast_out.desc: Revelation 12:9: strikes down the rebel angels in your gaze and around it. Lightning breaks their radiance; they fall through a fracture in the sky into the Underworld.
power.fiatlux.cast_out.no_war: There is no war in heaven. (Begin one with /fiatlux event rebellion.)
power.fiatlux.cast_out.none_near: No rebel angels are near your gaze. The rebels gather in Heaven: /fiatlux heaven
power.fiatlux.cosmic_spark.desc: "In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth." The Big Bang: galaxies are born. (Gen 1:1)
power.fiatlux.deluge.desc: The fountains of the deep break up and the waters prevail. (Gen 7:11)
power.fiatlux.evening_and_morning.desc: Brings the next dusk or dawn. "And the evening and the morning were the first day." (Gen 1:5)
power.fiatlux.fiat_lux.desc: "Let there be light: and there was light." Floods the darkness with unseen light. (Gen 1:3)
power.fiatlux.part_waters.desc: Opens a dry path through the sea, walled by stilled water. (Ex 14:21-22)
power.fiatlux.planetary_genesis.desc: Forms a new world and sets it in its orbit around the throne. (Gen 1:14-16)
power.fiatlux.raise_land.desc: Raises a hill of earth from the ground or the sea. (Gen 1:9)
power.fiatlux.send_angel.desc: Sends a ministering spirit clothed in linen. (Heb 1:14; Dan 10:5)
power.fiatlux.send_archangel.desc: 1 Thessalonians 4:16. A captain of the Host whose trumpet strikes down and hurls back every enemy around it.
power.fiatlux.send_principality.desc: Daniel 10:21. A prince over a people: it guards mortals from every hostile creature and shields them.
power.fiatlux.smite.desc: Calls down fire and lightning; the corrupt are consumed. (1 Kgs 18:38)
power.fiatlux.summon_cherub.desc: A living creature of four faces and four wings. (Ezek 1:5-11)
power.fiatlux.summon_dominion.desc: Colossians 1:16. A governor of the lower choirs: its sceptre strengthens the Host beneath it and burdens the corrupt.
power.fiatlux.summon_ophan.desc: A wheel within a wheel, its rims full of eyes. (Ezek 1:15-18)
power.fiatlux.summon_power.desc: Ephesians 6:12; Jude 1:6. An armoured warrior who strikes with the sword and binds the corrupt in chains; doubly fearsome to the fallen.
power.fiatlux.summon_seraph.desc: A burning one with six wings, crying Holy, holy, holy. (Isa 6:2-3)
power.fiatlux.summon_virtue.desc: Ephesians 1:21. A worker of signs and miracles: it heals the wounded and lifts afflictions.
power.fiatlux.visit_world.desc: Carries you to the next created world, to stand upon its ground under its own sky and gravity.
tooltip.fiatlux.flaming_sword.use: Use: wave of holy fire. Sneak-use on ground: station it as a guardian.
tooltip.fiatlux.scepter.use: Use: speak the selected power. Sneak-use: next power. [R] power wheel, [G] cast.
